name: rag_memory
description: Persistent RAG knowledge base at /data/rag_memory/rag.db (sqlite FTS5, BM25 ranked). Actions: 'add' (text, optional title/source/tags/doc_id - long text is auto-chunked), 'search' (query, limit, optional tags filter -> ranked chunks with snippets), 'get' (doc_id -> full document), 'list' (recent docs), 'delete' (doc_id), 'stats', 'ingest_url' (url -> fetches page text and stores it). Use to remember facts/notes/docs across sessions and to look things up before answering.
